challenges.finding: Host memory grew 4 to 11 GB and was killed: pedalboard treats Native as keeping audio on reset, so every reset render re-created the plugin and Native never freed an instance (+353 MB each). Fixed by resetting by state; renders are now 0.28 s instead of about 2 s and bit-identical to dedicated captures. Scores from runs before 2026-10-15T18:54 are not exactly reproducible (history-dependent at -62 to -72 dB).

The old and new reset paths disagree on randomly set parameters (levels 11.6 to 14.4 dB apart). The new path matches each file's own drop capture, so it is believed correct, but this is not independently confirmed.

A stale template was reused for a second file with the same chain structure but a different unmapped parameter, which produced a false parity row (voided). Templates are now keyed by structure plus a hash of baked values and legacy templates are refused.

SUPERSEDED 2026-10-16 (T082: the host's state reset clears every tail at any pre-roll, -291 to -316 dB; DECISIONS): Native's reset does not clear delay lines: a chain with an enabled delay alternates between two renders (-19.7 dB) at the default 0.1 s pre-roll; 3 s fixes it (-62 to -65 dB).

Block-serial: the -22.6 dB untrimmed result is an artefact of each instance's 16-sample delay against modulation; trimming 16 samples per instance gives -67.1 dB above 20 Hz, but the full band is limited to -50 dB by sub-5 Hz content from the delay. An Amp+Cab block is not exactly an amp block followed by a cab block (0.021 dB, -72.7 dB gain-matched). An unexplained -67 dB floor appears once the amp follows other blocks. Dual cab, stereo paths and non-default settings are not tested.

Native applies a drop-loaded file's block values and ignores its stale snapshot values (-330.1 dB versus -38.3 dB); capture now syncs snapshots to blocks. A block-bypass MIDI-CC encoding Native honours has not been found, so bypass patterns need one capture each.

Whole-preset state write is impossible (opaque encrypted records); the file drop is the supported route. The human clicked 'Change HC mode' once and ticked 'Don't ask again' to get a clean start state; no state edits were adopted.
The Native installer EULA is silent on training ML on Native renders; the human marked the EULA reading done but recorded no finding.

About 1 Native host process in 10 rendered every chain differently for its whole life (reverbs and modulated delays by -21 to -27 dB; parameters and saved state identical; cause unknown). A start-up check now replaces such hosts. Latency trims could also differ by up to 30 samples between engines; fixed by measuring once per engine with every block bypassed.
